reason: Alpha.6 PR4' (Lane 2) ships the review-wake DEFER plane: a pre-gate on the Leader control-notification port that holds a wake (never a decision) for one identified approval leg until a floor passes, plus the sixteenth team tool that files and lifts those quiets. DORMANT BY DEFAULT — nothing is wired to allow, and a team whose row config does not carry teamToolPlane.reviewDeferEnabled === true keeps fifteen tools and the untouched notifier, byte for byte. Four lane modules: types.ts (the five 'what this lane is NOT' laws — not a scheduler, not a second approval ledger, not a dedupe, not the retry mutex, not an authority; the key law that a wake with no approvalCaseId is never deferred, because muting what the lane cannot attribute is the one error the whole design exists to prevent; the closed vocabularies REVIEW_DEFER_DECISIONS / _WAKE_REASONS (4) / _REFUSALS (8) / _REASON_CODES (4) and the frozen default limits, one hour and sixty-four entries). store.ts (process-local Map keyed by (rootSessionId, approvalCaseId, legOrdinal), sweep-on-every-touch with no reaper and no timer, saturation refusing the NEW key rather than evicting a standing quiet). gate.ts (decideReviewWake pure and side-effect-free except retiring a passed floor; createReviewDeferGate wrapping the PORT, not the deliverer, because the deliverer only ever sees a rendered string; FAIL OPEN around the decision, notifier rejections propagated unchanged). index.ts (barrel + the dormancy statement naming root.ts as the sole consumer). Three runtime specs: a6-pr4-review-defer.test.ts (33 legs: decisions, store law, gate composition, tool contract, plane behaviour, both-directions vocabulary reachability), a6-pr4-mutex-negative.test.ts (the one-chooser negatives — the OFF path returns the untouched notifier BY REFERENCE, a case-less row is delivered with the plane fully on, no retraction, no dedupe claim, restart answers an early wake, and the compiler-proved assignability of a real ControlRequestRecord to the lane's candidate), a6-pr4-lane-hygiene.test.ts (dormancy walked from disk with exactly one allowed consumer, the single flag read and the single store/gate/port construction counted in root.ts, no clock no timer no node:, the shipped dist surface referenced only by root.js). One tools spec: a6-pr4-tool-surface.test.ts (the sixteenth tool exists exactly when its injected port does, satisfies the SD-TOKEN invariants every other team tool carries, and its model-facing description is pinned for content and size). Amendment in the same change: packages/tools/src/tool definitions, packages/tools/src/types.ts (the injected port, structural, no runtime-lane import), packages/runtime/src/plugin/root.ts (the only consumer, one flag read deciding gate AND tool from one store), both runtime tsconfigs, and two shared tool censuses — packages/tools/test/p6t6-bypass-scan.test.ts unchanged at fifteen (the default mount), and tests/kits/rc2-real-host-smoke/fixture-invariants.mjs TEAM_TOOL_CATALOG plus its testkit leg now sixteen DECLARED names, where the I2 stale fixture is kept historically true at eleven names and therefore now reports a five-tool drift instead of four.
